custom_logic_notes: GG-RSI-CCI is a custom composite indicator combining RSI and CCI with multi-stage smoothing (SmoothAlgorithms.mqh). The indicator outputs discrete states: 0=sell, 1=neutral, 2=buy via buffer 1. Entry requires state change (Value[0] must differ from Value[1] to confirm transition). SignalMode enum controls exit behavior: MODE_FLAT closes on neutral signal, MODE_TREND only closes on opposing signal. TradeAlgorithms.mqh provides BuyPositionOpen/SellPositionOpen/BuyPositionClose/SellPositionClose wrappers. The UpSignalTime/DnSignalTime uses bar open time + timeframe seconds for position identification via GlobalVariable.
python_conversion_notes: Must reimplement GG-RSI-CCI indicator logic in Python. The indicator combines RSI and CCI into a composite signal with configurable smoothing (SMMA default, but supports JJMA, JurX, ParMA, T3, VIDYA, AMA via SmoothAlgorithms). Key steps: (1) Implement RSI(period=8) and CCI(period=8) using applied price; (2) Apply two-stage smoothing with Period1=14 and Period2=20 using SMMA method; (3) Derive 3-state signal (0/1/2) from smoothed composite; (4) Implement state-change detection for entry; (5) Implement SignalMode-dependent exit logic. The TradeAlgorithms.mqh wrappers handle order execution with deviation, SL/TP in points, and position gating—these map to standard backtester order calls.
